title: The Pawn
subtitle: Small steps forward, captures sideways, dreams of promotion.
goals: Move pawns one or two squares forward
Promote a pawn into a queen

steps.say: Pawns are the soul of chess. They march straight forward one square at a time — or two squares on their very first move. But here's the twist: they capture diagonally, one square forward-left or forward-right.

autoMoves.say: Two squares from its starting post — allowed only on a pawn's first move.
Another two-square jump, offering a pawn duel...
...and Black captures diagonally. Pawns never capture straight ahead!

steps.prompt: Capture the black pawn with your pawn.
hints: Pawns capture diagonally — one square forward-left or forward-right.
Your e4 pawn can reach d5 with a diagonal capture.

line.say: That's it — one diagonal step forward. This is the ONLY way pawns capture.

rejections.say: You walked straight past it! Pawns capture diagonally, never straight ahead. The two pawns would just stare at each other forever.

steps.wrongSay: Use your pawn — the capture is one diagonal step forward.
steps.successSay: Diagonal captures — the number one rule new players forget. Not you though.

steps.prompt: Your pawn can capture two ways — but one pawn is defended. Take the free one!
hints: Check each target: after you capture, can a black pawn recapture diagonally?
d5 is guarded by the c6 pawn. Who's guarding f5? Nobody.

line.say: Correct! f5 was undefended — a pawn up, no strings attached.

rejections.say: cxd5 recaptures — an even trade at best. The other capture won a pawn for free.

steps.wrongSay: Your e4 pawn has two possible captures. Pick the pawn with no defender.
steps.successSay: Counting defenders before capturing — you're already thinking like a real player.

steps.prompt: Your pawn is one step from glory. Promote it!
hints: A pawn that reaches the last rank transforms into any piece you choose — almost always a queen.
Push the pawn to e8 and pick your new queen.

line.say: Promotion! Your humble pawn is now a queen — and she announces herself with check.

steps.wrongSay: Push the pawn forward — the eighth rank is where pawns become royalty.
steps.successSay: That transformation is why endgames revolve around pawns. Every pawn is a future queen.

steps.prompt: It's a race! Black's h-pawn is running too — promote first!
hints: Count the moves: your pawn needs two steps, Black's needs three. Push!
e7 first, then e8 — you win the race by one tempo.

line.say: Queen — with check! You won the race, and your new queen will easily stop Black's pawn.

rejections.say: Your king can't catch the h-pawn AND your own pawn stands still. In pawn races, every single move counts — push!

steps.wrongSay: No time for detours — this is a footrace to the eighth rank.
steps.successSay: Pawn races are won by one tempo. Always count the steps before choosing to run.
